I now have a comprehensive picture of the Tutors platform. Here is my thorough analysis.

---

## Tutors Platform Feature Surface Area Analysis

### 1. Content Types Supported (Learning Object Types)

The platform supports a rich set of learning object (LO) types. Based on the icon library (`src/lib/services/themes/icons/fluent-icons.ts`), route structure, lo-tree builder (`src/lib/services/course/services/lo-tree.ts`), and UI components:

**Structural / Container Types:**
- **Course** -- top-level container with properties, metadata, calendar, enrollment whitelist
- **Topic** -- primary organizational unit within a course
- **Unit** -- grouping within a topic
- **Side** -- secondary grouping (sidebar-style units)
- **Tutorial** -- guided learning path with PDF support

**Content Types:**
- **Lab** -- multi-step interactive lab content with markdown steps, sidebar navigation, keyboard arrow-key navigation, step auto-numbering, and PDF export. Route: `/lab/[courseid]/[...loid]`
- **Talk / PanelTalk** -- presentation slides. Three renderers: Adobe PDF embed, Mozilla PDF.js, and **Marp** (markdown-based slides with Mermaid diagram support). Supports fullscreen, slide navigation with keyboard. Routes: `/talk/`, `/paneltalk/`
- **Note / PanelNote** -- rich markdown content (full-page notes that hide the main navigator). Route: `/note/`
- **Video / PanelVideo** -- embedded video from multiple services: YouTube, Vimeo, HEAnet, VIMP. Route: `/video/`
- **Notebook** -- Jupyter notebook rendering with code cells, markdown cells, raw cells, exercise/solution tagging, execution count display, and output rendering (stream, execute_result, display_data, error, images, HTML, SVG, LaTeX). Route: `/notebook/`
- **Podcast** -- Spotify episode embedding via iframe. Identified by `episode.id`
- **Archive** -- downloadable file archives (zip, etc.)
- **Web** -- external web links (filtered out during tree construction but used as companion links)
- **GitHub** -- GitHub repository links
- **Reference** -- document references
- **Step** -- individual steps within a lab

**Content Authoring Pipeline:**
- All content is authored as **Markdown** and processed by `markdown-it`
- Content is hosted externally (typically on Netlify as static `tutors.json` files)
- Course structure is defined by directory convention, not a web-based editor

### 2. Learner-Facing Features

**Present:**
- **Course Visit Tracking** -- records which courses a learner has visited, visit count, last access timestamp. Stored in both localStorage (anonymous) and Supabase (authenticated). File: `src/lib/services/connect/services/localStorageProfile.ts` and `supabaseProfile.svelte.ts`
- **Favorites/Stars** -- learners can star/unstar courses from their dashboard. The `CourseVisit` type has a `favourite: boolean` field. File: `src/lib/services/connect/types.ts`
- **Search** -- full-text search across labs, steps, notes, and panel notes within a course. Searches markdown content and renders results with syntax highlighting. Route: `/search/[courseid]`. File: `src/routes/(course-reader)/search/[courseid]/+page.svelte`
- **Time Tracking ("Tutors Time")** -- tracks time spent on each learning object (updated every 30 seconds via timer). Shows calendar heatmaps (daily activity, lab activity), comparison to course median, and tabular breakdowns (by week, by day, by lab, by lab step). Route: `/time/[courseid]`. Uses external `@tutors/tutors-time-lib`
- **Dark/Light Mode** -- togglable, persisted to localStorage
- **Multiple Themes** -- tutors, classic, dyslexia, terminus, rose, cerberus, easter (with special icons), festive (with snow animation)
- **Course Sentiment** -- learners can express their current sentiment: neutral, fine, delighted, confident, overwhelmed, confused, drained. Persisted to Supabase. File: `src/lib/ui/navigators/buttons/CourseSentimentButton.svelte`
- **Course Tree/TOC** -- table of contents sidebar for navigating the course structure
- **Breadcrumbs** -- hierarchical breadcrumb navigation
- **Calendar** -- academic calendar showing week numbers, types, and start dates with current week highlighting. File: `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/Calendar.svelte`
- **LLM Export (llms.txt)** -- generates LLM-consumable text files and PDF archives following the llms.txt convention. Route: `/llm/[courseid]`
- **Layout Customization** -- card style (portrait/circular/landscape), layout (expanded/compacted), code theme selection (7 Shiki themes)
- **Keyboard Navigation** -- arrow keys for lab steps and slide navigation

**Accessibility Features:**
- **Dyslexia theme** -- dedicated CSS theme using OpenDyslexic font with carefully tuned color palette. File: `src/lib/services/themes/styles/dyslexia.css`
- **Skip to content link** -- `sr-only` link visible on focus. File: `src/lib/ui/TutorsShell.svelte`
- **Reduced motion support** -- respects `prefers-reduced-motion` media query, disables animations accordingly. File: `src/lib/services/a11y/reduced-motion.svelte.ts`
- **ARIA landmarks** -- `aria-label` on nav, footer, sidebar elements
- **Main content focus management** -- `tabindex="-1"` on main, focused after navigation
- **Semantic HTML** -- proper `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<header>`, `<footer>`, `<article>` usage
- **i18n for a11y labels** -- accessibility strings like "Skip to content", "Main navigation", "Breadcrumbs" are internationalized

**NOT Present:**
- No **progress tracking / completion percentage** -- no checkboxes, no "mark as complete", no progress bars for course completion
- No **bookmarks within content** -- only course-level favorites, not content-level
- No **notifications** -- no in-app notification system
- No **certificates** or **badges** -- no completion certificates or achievement badges
- No **gamification** -- no points, leaderboards, achievements, or streaks
- No **learner analytics dashboard** -- the time view exists but is minimal (personal time only)
- No **offline support / PWA** -- no service worker, no manifest.json, no caching strategy
- No **mobile app** -- web-only, responsive design via Tailwind breakpoints

### 3. Instructor/Educator Features

**Present:**
- **"Educator Time"** -- links to external `time.tutors.dev` for per-course analytics. File: `src/lib/ui/navigators/tutors-connect/ConnectedProfile.svelte` (menu item: `(Educator Time)`)
- **Tutors Live** -- real-time view of students currently online in a course, with tabbed activity views (Today, This Week, This Month, This Year). Route: `/live/[courseid]`
- **Student Presence Tracking** -- sees which students are online and what LO they are viewing
- **Learning Event Tracking** -- all page loads and time spent are recorded to Supabase (`learning_records` table) with student_id, course_id, lo_id, duration, count, type, date_last_accessed
- **Calendar Data** -- per-student calendar entries tracking `timeactive` and `pageloads` per day
- **Edit Course Button** -- direct link to the GitHub source of the current content (lab step, note, etc.) for editing. File: `src/lib/ui/navigators/buttons/EditCoursButton.svelte`
- **Course Whitelist/Enrollment** -- `enrollment.whitelist` mechanism to restrict access to specific GitHub logins. File: `src/lib/services/connect/services/connect.svelte.ts`
- **Private Courses** -- `authLevel` and `isPrivate` flags force authentication
- **Catalogue Management** -- admin functions to prune invalid courses and delete courses. File: `src/lib/services/community/services/catalogue.ts`

**NOT Present:**
- No **grading system** -- no grades, rubrics, or scoring
- No **quiz/assessment engine** -- no MCQ, fill-in-the-blank, auto-graded exercises
- No **assignment submission** -- no file upload or submission workflow
- No **peer review** -- no peer assessment mechanism
- No **discussion forums** -- no threaded discussions
- No **announcements** -- no instructor-to-student messaging
- No **rubrics** -- no structured evaluation criteria
- No **gradebook** -- no aggregated student performance view (beyond time tracking)

### 4. Collaboration Features

**Present:**
- **Real-time Presence** -- via PartyKit WebSockets. Students can see who else is online in their course and what content they are viewing. File: `src/lib/services/community/services/presence.svelte.ts`
- **Share Presence Toggle** -- students can opt in/out of presence sharing. File: `src/lib/services/connect/services/connect.svelte.ts`
- **Online Student List** -- sidebar showing currently online students with avatar, name, and what LO they are viewing. File: `src/lib/ui/navigators/buttons/OnlineButton.svelte`
- **Sentiment Sharing** -- students can share their emotional state (visible to those monitoring the course)

**NOT Present:**
- No **chat** -- no text chat between students or with instructors
- No **forums/discussions** -- no threaded discussions on content
- No **comments** -- no ability to comment on learning objects
- No **group work** -- no team/group formation or collaboration spaces
- No **peer assessment** -- no peer grading workflow
- No **collaborative editing** -- content is static, authored via GitHub

### 5. Integrations

**Present:**
- **GitHub OAuth** -- the only SSO/auth provider. File: `src/hooks.server.ts`, uses `@auth/core/providers/github`
- **Supabase** -- backend for analytics, user profiles, course catalogue, calendar data. Tables: `learning_records`, `calendar`, `tutors-connect-users`, `tutors-connect-courses`, `tutors-connect-profiles`, `tutors-connect-latest`
- **PartyKit** -- real-time WebSocket presence system
- **Netlify** -- default deployment target (course content hosted as `*.netlify.app` subdomains). File: `src/lib/services/course/services/lo-tree.ts`
- **Spotify** -- podcast episode embedding
- **Companion Links** -- icon support for Slack, Moodle, YouTube, Zoom, Microsoft Teams. File: `src/lib/services/themes/icons/fluent-icons.ts`
- **GitHub API** -- fetches user profile names when not available from auth

**NOT Present:**
- No **LTI** integration
- No **SCORM** support
- No **xAPI** (Experience API) support
- No **SSO beyond GitHub** -- no Google, Microsoft, SAML, OIDC generic provider
- No **LMS integration** -- Moodle icon is for companion links only, not deep integration
- No **external tool embedding** (beyond video/podcast iframes)
- No **Webhook/API** for external systems to push/pull data

### 6. Content Authoring Features

**Markdown Pipeline:**
- **markdown-it** as the parser (from `@tutors/tutors-model-lib`)
- **Shiki** syntax highlighting with 29 programming languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, HTML, JSON, YAML, Markdown, Bash, Python, SQL, Java, Kotlin, C#, C, C++, Go, Rust, PHP, Ruby, Swift, Dockerfile, JSX, Svelte, Haskell, Scala, PowerShell, R, Shell, XML, Vue
- **7 code themes**: ayu-dark, monokai, github-dark, night-owl, solarized-light, github-light, catppuccin-latte
- **Mermaid diagrams** -- inline Mermaid diagram rendering with dark/light mode support. File: `src/lib/services/markdown/services/mermaid-action.ts`
- **Marp presentations** -- markdown-to-slides via `@marp-team/marp-core`, supporting themes, pagination, fullscreen, keyboard navigation. File: `src/lib/services/markdown/services/marp-renderer.ts`
- **KaTeX** -- LaTeX math rendering via CDN stylesheet (loaded in Lab and Note components)
- **PDF rendering** -- via `pdfjs-dist` (Mozilla PDF.js) or Adobe embed
- **Copy code button** -- automatically attached to code blocks. File: `src/lib/services/markdown/actions/copy-code-action.ts`
- **DOMPurify sanitization** -- all rendered HTML is sanitized with DOMPurify, allowing iframes, video, audio, embed tags. File: `src/lib/utils/sanitize.ts`
- **Front matter support** -- learning objects support YAML front matter for metadata (icons, marp settings, etc.)
- **URL filtering/rewriting** -- markdown URLs are rewritten to match course deployment URLs

**Authoring Model:**
- Content is authored as files in a GitHub repository following directory conventions
- No in-app WYSIWYG editor -- all editing happens in GitHub (the Edit button links directly to GitHub)
- Course is compiled externally (via `tutors-apps` tools) into a `tutors.json` tree structure and deployed as a static site

### 7. i18n/Localization Support

**Maturity: Moderate**
- **5 languages supported**: English, French, German, Italian, Spanish. File: `src/lib/services/i18n/index.ts`
- **~80+ translation keys** covering: navigation, menus, home page, course reader, live page, auth, time tables, content, footer, errors, accessibility labels
- **Language switcher UI** -- dropdown in the Layout menu. File: `src/lib/ui/components/LanguageSwitcher.svelte`
- **Cookie-based persistence** -- locale stored in cookie, read server-side in hooks, and set as `document.documentElement.lang`
- **Server-side locale detection** -- `initLocaleFromCookie` in the server handle. File: `src/hooks.server.ts`

**Gaps:**
- No RTL (right-to-left) language support
- The `auth.terms` block (a long legal text) is only translated in English -- other languages don't include it
- Content itself is not localized (course content is authored in whatever language the instructor chooses)
- No auto-detection from browser `Accept-Language` header
- No pluralization handling in the translation function

### 8. PWA/Offline Capabilities

**None.** There is:
- No `manifest.json` or `manifest.webmanifest`
- No service worker
- No Workbox or caching strategy
- No offline fallback pages
- The application is purely online -- it fetches course JSON from Netlify domains at runtime
- The `.tessl` directory contains SvelteKit documentation mentioning service workers, but this is just reference material, not implemented code

### Summary of Key Gaps vs. MOOCs/Open Education Platforms

| Feature Area | Status |
|---|---|
| Content types | Strong -- rich variety including labs, talks, notebooks, podcasts, videos |
| Content authoring | Git-based only -- no in-app editor or WYSIWYG |
| Search | Basic -- within-course only, no cross-platform search |
| Progress tracking | Absent -- no completion tracking, progress bars, or learning paths |
| Assessments / Quizzes | Absent -- no quiz engine, auto-grading, or rubrics |
| Certificates / Badges | Absent -- no completion recognition |
| Gamification | Absent -- no points, leaderboards, streaks |
| Discussion / Forums | Absent -- no learner-to-learner or learner-to-instructor communication |
| Peer Review | Absent |
| Analytics | Present but limited -- time tracking only, no learning outcome analytics |
| Real-time presence | Strong -- WebSocket-based live tracking |
| Authentication | GitHub-only SSO |
| LTI / SCORM / xAPI | Absent -- no interoperability standards |
| i18n | Moderate -- 5 languages, good coverage of UI strings |
| Accessibility | Good foundation -- dyslexia font, reduced motion, skip links, ARIA |
| Offline / PWA | Absent |
| Mobile | Responsive via Tailwind, but no native app or PWA |
| Notifications | Absent |
| Grading / Gradebook | Absent |
| Group collaboration | Absent |

Uses external `@tutors/tutors-time-lib`
- **Dark/Light Mode** -- togglable, persisted to localStorage
- **Multiple Themes** -- tutors, classic, dyslexia, terminus, rose, cerberus, easter (with special icons), festive (with snow animation)
- **Course Sentiment** -- learners can express their current sentiment: neutral, fine, delighted, confident, overwhelmed, confused, drained. Persisted to Supabase. File: `src/lib/ui/navigators/buttons/CourseSentimentButton.svelte`
- **Course Tree/TOC** -- table of contents sidebar for navigating the course structure
- **Breadcrumbs** -- hierarchical breadcrumb navigation
- **Calendar** -- academic calendar showing week numbers, types, and start dates with current week highlighting. File: `src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/Calendar.svelte`
- **LLM Export (llms.txt)** -- generates LLM-consumable text files and PDF archives following the llms.txt convention. Route: `/llm/[courseid]`
- **Layout Customization** -- card style (portrait/circular/landscape), layout (expanded/compacted), code theme selection (7 Shiki themes)
- **Keyboard Navigation** -- arrow keys for lab steps and slide navigation

**Accessibility Features:**
- **Dyslexia theme** -- dedicated CSS theme using OpenDyslexic font with carefully tuned color palette. File: `src/lib/services/themes/styles/dyslexia.css`
- **Skip to content link** -- `sr-only` link visible on focus. File: `src/lib/ui/TutorsShell.svelte`
- **Reduced motion support** -- respects `prefers-reduced-motion` media query, disables animations accordingly. File: `src/lib/services/a11y/reduced-motion.svelte.ts`
- **ARIA landmarks** -- `aria-label` on nav, footer, sidebar elements
- **Main content focus management** -- `tabindex="-1"` on main, focused after navigation
- **Semantic HTML** -- proper `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<header>`, `<footer>`, `<article>` usage
- **i18n for a11y labels** -- accessibility strings like "Skip to content", "Main navigation", "Breadcrumbs" are internationalized

**NOT Present:**
- No **progress tracking / completion percentage** -- no checkboxes, no "mark as complete", no progress bars for course completion
- No **bookmarks within content** -- only course-level favorites, not content-level
- No **notifications** -- no in-app notification system
- No **certificates** or **badges** -- no completion certificates or achievement badges
- No **gamification** -- no points, leaderboards, achievements, or streaks
- No **learner analytics dashboard** -- the time view exists but is minimal (personal time only)
- No **offline support / PWA** -- no service worker, no manifest.json, no caching strategy
- No **mobile app** -- web-only, responsive design via Tailwind breakpoints

### 3. Instructor/Educator Features

**Present:**
- **"Educator Time"** -- links to external `time.tutors.dev` for per-course analytics. File: `src/lib/ui/navigators/tutors-connect/ConnectedProfile.svelte` (menu item: `(Educator Time)`)
- **Tutors Live** -- real-time view of students currently online in a course, with tabbed activity views (Today, This Week, This Month, This Year). Route: `/live/[courseid]`
- **Student Presence Tracking** -- sees which students are online and what LO they are viewing
- **Learning Event Tracking** -- all page loads and time spent are recorded to Supabase (`learning_records` table) with student_id, course_id, lo_id, duration, count, type, date_last_accessed
- **Calendar Data** -- per-student calendar entries tracking `timeactive` and `pageloads` per day
- **Edit Course Button** -- direct link to the GitHub source of the current content (lab step, note, etc.) for editing. File: `src/lib/ui/navigators/buttons/EditCoursButton.svelte`
- **Course Whitelist/Enrollment** -- `enrollment.whitelist` mechanism to restrict access to specific GitHub logins. File: `src/lib/services/connect/services/connect.svelte.ts`
- **Private Courses** -- `authLevel` and `isPrivate` flags force authentication
- **Catalogue Management** -- admin functions to prune invalid courses and delete courses. File: `src/lib/services/community/services/catalogue.ts`

**NOT Present:**
- No **grading system** -- no grades, rubrics, or scoring
- No **quiz/assessment engine** -- no MCQ, fill-in-the-blank, auto-graded exercises
- No **assignment submission** -- no file upload or submission workflow
- No **peer review** -- no peer assessment mechanism
- No **discussion forums** -- no threaded discussions
- No **announcements** -- no instructor-to-student messaging
- No **rubrics** -- no structured evaluation criteria
- No **gradebook** -- no aggregated student performance view (beyond time tracking)

### 4. Collaboration Features

**Present:**
- **Real-time Presence** -- via PartyKit WebSockets. Students can see who else is online in their course and what content they are viewing. File: `src/lib/services/community/services/presence.svelte.ts`
- **Share Presence Toggle** -- students can opt in/out of presence sharing. File: `src/lib/services/connect/services/connect.svelte.ts`
- **Online Student List** -- sidebar showing currently online students with avatar, name, and what LO they are viewing. File: `src/lib/ui/navigators/buttons/OnlineButton.svelte`
- **Sentiment Sharing** -- students can share their emotional state (visible to those monitoring the course)

**NOT Present:**
- No **chat** -- no text chat between students or with instructors
- No **forums/discussions** -- no threaded discussions on content
- No **comments** -- no ability to comment on learning objects
- No **group work** -- no team/group formation or collaboration spaces
- No **peer assessment** -- no peer grading workflow
- No **collaborative editing** -- content is static, authored via GitHub

### 5. Integrations

**Present:**
- **GitHub OAuth** -- the only SSO/auth provider. File: `src/hooks.server.ts`, uses `@auth/core/providers/github`
- **Supabase** -- backend for analytics, user profiles, course catalogue, calendar data. Tables: `learning_records`, `calendar`, `tutors-connect-users`, `tutors-connect-courses`, `tutors-connect-profiles`, `tutors-connect-latest`
- **PartyKit** -- real-time WebSocket presence system
- **Netlify** -- default deployment target (course content hosted as `*.netlify.app` subdomains). File: `src/lib/services/course/services/lo-tree.ts`
- **Spotify** -- podcast episode embedding
- **Companion Links** -- icon support for Slack, Moodle, YouTube, Zoom, Microsoft Teams. File: `src/lib/services/themes/icons/fluent-icons.ts`
- **GitHub API** -- fetches user profile names when not available from auth

**NOT Present:**
- No **LTI** integration
- No **SCORM** support
- No **xAPI** (Experience API) support
- No **SSO beyond GitHub** -- no Google, Microsoft, SAML, OIDC generic provider
- No **LMS integration** -- Moodle icon is for companion links only, not deep integration
- No **external tool embedding** (beyond video/podcast iframes)
- No **Webhook/API** for external systems to push/pull data

### 6. Content Authoring Features

**Markdown Pipeline:**
- **markdown-it** as the parser (from `@tutors/tutors-model-lib`)
- **Shiki** syntax highlighting with 29 programming languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, HTML, JSON, YAML, Markdown, Bash, Python, SQL, Java, Kotlin, C#, C, C++, Go, Rust, PHP, Ruby, Swift, Dockerfile, JSX, Svelte, Haskell, Scala, PowerShell, R, Shell, XML, Vue
- **7 code themes**: ayu-dark, monokai, github-dark, night-owl, solarized-light, github-light, catppuccin-latte
- **Mermaid diagrams** -- inline Mermaid diagram rendering with dark/light mode support. File: `src/lib/services/markdown/services/mermaid-action.ts`
- **Marp presentations** -- markdown-to-slides via `@marp-team/marp-core`, supporting themes, pagination, fullscreen, keyboard navigation. File: `src/lib/services/markdown/services/marp-renderer.ts`
- **KaTeX** -- LaTeX math rendering via CDN stylesheet (loaded in Lab and Note components)
- **PDF rendering** -- via `pdfjs-dist` (Mozilla PDF.js) or Adobe embed
- **Copy code button** -- automatically attached to code blocks. File: `src/lib/services/markdown/actions/copy-code-action.ts`
- **DOMPurify sanitization** -- all rendered HTML is sanitized with DOMPurify, allowing iframes, video, audio, embed tags. File: `src/lib/utils/sanitize.ts`
- **Front matter support** -- learning objects support YAML front matter for metadata (icons, marp settings, etc.)
- **URL filtering/rewriting** -- markdown URLs are rewritten to match course deployment URLs

**Authoring Model:**
- Content is authored as files in a GitHub repository following directory conventions
- No in-app WYSIWYG editor -- all editing happens in GitHub (the Edit button links directly to GitHub)
- Course is compiled externally (via `tutors-apps` tools) into a `tutors.json` tree structure and deployed as a static site

### 7. i18n/Localization Support

**Maturity: Moderate**
- **5 languages supported**: English, French, German, Italian, Spanish. File: `src/lib/services/i18n/index.ts`
- **~80+ translation keys** covering: navigation, menus, home page, course reader, live page, auth, time tables, content, footer, errors, accessibility labels
- **Language switcher UI** -- dropdown in the Layout menu. File: `src/lib/ui/components/LanguageSwitcher.svelte`
- **Cookie-based persistence** -- locale stored in cookie, read server-side in hooks, and set as `document.documentElement.lang`
- **Server-side locale detection** -- `initLocaleFromCookie` in the server handle. File: `src/hooks.server.ts`

**Gaps:**
- No RTL (right-to-left) language support
- The `auth.terms` block (a long legal text) is only translated in English -- other languages don't include it
- Content itself is not localized (course content is authored in whatever language the instructor chooses)
- No auto-detection from browser `Accept-Language` header
- No pluralization handling in the translation function

### 8. PWA/Offline Capabilities

**None.** There is:
- No `manifest.json` or `manifest.webmanifest`
- No service worker
- No Workbox or caching strategy
- No offline fallback pages
- The application is purely online -- it fetches course JSON from Netlify domains at runtime
- The `.tessl` directory contains SvelteKit documentation mentioning service workers, but this is just reference material, not implemented code

### Summary of Key Gaps vs. MOOCs/Open Education Platforms

| Feature Area | Status |
|---|---|
| Content types | Strong -- rich variety including labs, talks, notebooks, podcasts, videos |
| Content authoring | Git-based only -- no in-app editor or WYSIWYG |
| Search | Basic -- within-course only, no cross-platform search |
| Progress tracking | Absent -- no completion tracking, progress bars, or learning paths |
| Assessments / Quizzes | Absent -- no quiz engine, auto-grading, or rubrics |
| Certificates / Badges | Absent -- no completion recognition |
| Gamification | Absent -- no points, leaderboards, streaks |
| Discussion / Forums | Absent -- no learner-to-learner or learner-to-instructor communication |
| Peer Review | Absent |
| Analytics | Present but limited -- time tracking only, no learning outcome analytics |
| Real-time presence | Strong -- WebSocket-based live tracking |
| Authentication | GitHub-only SSO |
| LTI / SCORM / xAPI | Absent -- no interoperability standards |
| i18n | Moderate -- 5 languages, good coverage of UI strings |
| Accessibility | Good foundation -- dyslexia font, reduced motion, skip links, ARIA |
| Offline / PWA | Absent |
| Mobile | Responsive via Tailwind, but no native app or PWA |
| Notifications | Absent |
| Grading / Gradebook | Absent |
| Group collaboration | Absent |
